i.norm: Verifies that the Match Rating Approach (MRA) encoder recognises "Zach" and "Zacharia" as phonetically equivalent. Under MRA, both names reduce to the same consonant skeleton after vowel removal and double-consonant collapsing, so their similarity rating meets the minimum threshold required for a positive match.
"Zach" and "Zacharia" are common nickname / full-name variants of the same person's name. The MRA algorithm should consider them a successful match (isEncodeEquals returns true).
